# Residual AAC syntax and numerical spectra

Residual plus LD-filter movie syntax is nonconforming for the native LD codec;
see `docs/LD_MPS_PROFILE.md`. Its native test requires profile refusal,while
standalone residual parsing retains spectrum and reserved-book checks.
This does not establish ordinary MPEG Surround/HQ residual integration.
Fixtures are own synthetic media;ordinary tests require no external tool/network.
